correctness_confidence.basis: All proofs, spectral identities, descendant SRG parameters, normalized Gegenbauer polynomials G2/G4/G6, beyond-wall rational duals (66, 100, 294), odd-q barrier equivalences, Kronecker block eigenvalues, and conference-matrix saturations check out exactly.

rigor.basis: Algebraic claims are proved constructively without floating-point arithmetic, and Section 5 explicitly isolates machine-checked Lean 4.36.0 theorems from external literature imports such as zonal kernel PSD-ness, SRG nonexistence, and lattice constructions.

novelty.basis: While the sharp values N(18..20) and fixed-angle constructions belong to Djaljapayan-Liao-Yu [5], the paper contributes an exact-Q zero-float dual-certificate framework, uniform a>=7 dominance proof, and exact odd-q barrier equivalence.

significance.basis: Provides an audit-grade, zero-float algebraic and spectral verification layer for delicate equiangular-line bounds in dimensions 18-23 and high-dimensional odd-q regimes, eliminating rounding ambiguity in SDP and integrality arguments.

reproducibility.basis: Specifies Lean 4.36.0 axiom footprint, test counts, and MIT licensing for code and certificates, though the PDF omits an explicit repository URL, raw SHA-256 digests, and inline proof scripts for standalone verification.

summary: This manuscript presents EQUILINE-SDP-DUAL-CERT-1.0, an exact-rational, zero-float algebraic verification and semidefinite dual-certificate framework covering real equiangular lines in dimensions 18-23 and high-dimensional fixed-angle regimes. Independently checking every formula and numerical certificate in the PDF confirms complete mathematical accuracy: (1) regular two-graph square-trace and descendant SRG parameter audits cleanly separate the d=18 non-integer relative ceiling (432/7, floor 61), the nonexistent feasible SRGs at d=19, 20, and the realized regular two-graphs at d=21-23; (2) Theorem 2.2 constructively proves N_{1/a}(d) <= 42 for all d <= 23 and a >= 7; (3) exact rational degree-4 Gegenbauer duals operate strictly past the d*alpha^2 = 1 wall, certifying N_{1/3}(18) <= 66, exact integer N_{1/3}(23) <= 100, and N_{1/5}(28) <= 294; and (4) Theorem 4.1 establishes the exact equivalence N_{1/q}(d) <= d+e-1 <=> d^2+(e-1)d < e*q^2, instantiated at q=319 (d<=898, e=8) and q=5599 (d<=27417, e=24), alongside Kronecker Seidel-block spectra and symmetric conference-matrix saturation at d=19, 23. The verification boundary in Section 5 is unusually transparent, clearly separating machine-checked Lean 4.36.0 algebra from cited literature results.
strengths: Exact algebraic and numerical correctness across all 16 certificates (C01-C16), including descendant SRGs, normalized Gegenbauer polynomials G2/G4/G6, and beyond-wall rational evaluations.
Exemplary verification-boundary discipline in Section 5, explicitly distinguishing machine-checked Lean 4.36.0 theorems from cited external theorems such as zonal PSD-ness and SRG nonexistence.
Clean exact equivalence characterizing the odd-q compression barrier (Theorem 4.1) and constructive uniform dominance bound N_{1/a}(d) <= 42 for all d <= 23 and a >= 7 (Theorem 2.2).
Transparent exact-Q degree-4 Gegenbauer SDP duals yielding rational and exact-integer bounds strictly beyond the Lemmens-Seidel wall d*alpha^2 = 1 without floating-point rounding risk.
weaknesses: Major breakthroughs (N(18)=57, N(19)=72, N(20)=90, and sharp fixed-angle constructions) come from [5], so the manuscript's primary contribution is formalization and rational certification rather than new optimal line systems.

Beyond-wall pure-G4 bounds at alpha=1/3 (66 at d=18, 100 at d=23) are looser than classical Lemmens-Seidel 2(d-1) bounds, serving as clean degree-4 dual demonstrations rather than tightest known bounds.
From the PDF alone, the external Lean source, Python verifier, and actual SHA-256 digest strings for C01-C16 are not printed or linked via an explicit URL, limiting standalone artifact inspection.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact equivalence d^2+(e-1)d < e*q^2 characterizing precisely when the Lemmens-Seidel relative bound forces N_{1/q}(d) <= d+e-1, with boundary reversals verified at q=319 and q=5599.
Zero-float exact-Q degree-4 Gegenbauer SDP dual certificates strictly past d*alpha^2 = 1, notably the exact integer certificate N_{1/3}(23) <= 100 from G_4^(23)(1/3) = -1/99.
Constructive machine-checked uniform dominance bound proving N_{1/a}(d) <= 42 for all d <= 23 and integers a >= 7, ruling out large reciprocal cosines across dimensions 18-23.
